title: design(auth,icons): the wave 3 windows 11 surfaces — the clock rides the left and the fluent icon set answers
body: The redesign the owner ordered. The auth surface splits into six componentes under Sol/componentes/auth (lockface carrying the clock on the LEFT side of the lock screen per the owner law, signinform with the windows password well, providerrow with the continue-with-devthink doors, pairingform, powermenu and statusline) while the anchor keeps only the stage machine — and the whole 27-icon set of the shell swaps to the windows 11 fluent grammar: rounded squircle plates, one calm two-tone gradient per app identity, bold white glyphs, one reusable plate helper, the export surface untouched.
